title: Tzedakah and chesed
description: DRAFTED (needs review before the page shows it): What the Gemara's aggados teach about giving: how much, to whom, and why giving is what keeps wealth alive.
notes: kesuvos 5, 6, 9 are the core; chagigah 4 'help before the trouble grows' should also match.

title: Marriage, the chuppah and the Jewish home
description: DRAFTED (needs review): Zivugim decreed in Heaven, the chuppah, sheva brachos, the wife who sends her husband to learn, and what each brings out in the other.
notes: kesuvos 1-4, 7, 8. Careful: kesuvos 5/6/9 are tzedakah shiurim with isolated marriage chapters; score_min may need raising.

title: The value of learning Torah
description: DRAFTED (needs review): Why learning Torah outranks everything else: even one hour counts, review defeats forgetting, and Torah stays with one who rises early and stays late.
notes: Must not match every shiur that merely says 'Torah' — keywords are action-of-learning phrases.

title: Shabbos and Yom Tov
description: DRAFTED (needs review): Shabbos as Hashem's hidden gift, the extra neshamah, half of Yom Tov for Hashem and half for yourself, and how the Gemara's aggados carry the kedushah of the day.
notes: Baitza is a Yom Tov masechta — expect most Baitza shiurim to match; that is correct, not over-matching.

title: Gehinnom and the judgment
description: DRAFTED (needs review): The Gemara's picture of judgment and Gehinnom: hidden and revealed deeds, the doors that lead there, and what cleanses a person.
notes: eruvin 1-2 and chagigah 3 are core; 'judgment' also appears in kesuvos 3 KI.

title: Angels, the heavens and the Merkavah
description: DRAFTED (needs review): Malachim in the Gemara — the Angel of Death, the angels of peace, the seven heavens, and what may be learned of the Merkavah.
notes: chagigah 3, 8, 9, 10. 'heaven' must match 'seven heavens' but watch 'Heaven' meaning Hashem ('fear of Heaven') — eruvin 2 KI says 'fear of Heaven'.

title: Emunah, bitachon and parnassah
description: DRAFTED (needs review): Livelihood is set on Rosh Hashanah; worry and bitachon; Hashem gives each person his food in its time. The Gemara's aggados on trusting Him.

title: Guarding the eyes and the tongue
description: DRAFTED (needs review): What a person says and sees is never lost: words hover in the air and are recounted before him, and Chazal build fences around eyes and speech.
notes: chagigah 4, 7; kesuvos 1, 3, 5; eruvin 1. 'words' may be too broad — check output.

title: The tzaddik and his power
description: DRAFTED (needs review): What a tzaddik is in the Gemara: the world stands on him, his words have power, his thought alone can affect another person, and even his animal is kept from sin.
notes: Word-boundary matching must not catch 'tzaddikim' twice or miss plurals — both listed.

title: The creation and the hidden light
description: DRAFTED (needs review): The light of the first day, hidden for the tzaddikim and reachable through the Torah; Adam and all the souls; why the world was created unfinished, so people complete it.
notes: chagigah 7, 8, 9('s heavens overlap is fine); 'adam' must not match 'Adam' inside other words — word boundary handles it.

title: Korbanos and the Beis Hamikdash
description: DRAFTED (needs review): The korbanos and what was lost with the churban: olos and shelamim, the mizbeach, the wings that sing, and what we ask to return.
notes: chagigah 5, 6, 10; baitza 3; eruvin 1; kesuvos 3 has 'What the mizbeach does' — one chapter hit only, may not qualify at score_min 2. That is acceptable.

title: Teshuvah
description: DRAFTED (needs review): Returning: Adam as the first baal teshuvah, fences so one does not fall back, regret, and the Kotzker on sin and repentance.
notes: Expected ~2 shiurim at Nov 2026 — likely below threshold; kept in the taxonomy so the page appears when the third shiur lands.

title: Mourning and comforting mourners
description: DRAFTED (needs review): What Chazal teach about death and the mourner's home: the limits set on mourning, burial in simple linen, and death and atonement.
notes: kesuvos 2 core; kesuvos 8 has widows. Watch kesuvos 3 'Why a widow is called almanah' — one chapter hit, should not qualify the shiur alone.

title: Davening and its power
description: DRAFTED (needs review): Davening takes the place of the korbanos; how to ask — as a child asks a parent, not as one who deserves.
notes: chagigah 6, kesuvos 3 — expect ~2, below threshold at launch.
